frontmatter.title: Recognize the exact native Codex receipt-v1 passing envelope

sections.content:
## Context

The human explicitly included the prepared narrow one-point Codex format repair
in the finite B1–B3 batch on 2026-10-16. ETA PR21 has current passing checks and
real current-head MiMo and Codex reviews. Its preserved native Codex comment
6206360170 begins with the exact receipt-v1 HTML marker and two LF bytes. Three
canonical anchored-prefix recognizers do not accept that envelope; this is an
observed parser mismatch, not a provider or authentication failure.

Existing pure-law diagnosis preserves the raw comment and separately uses the
actual GitHub-resolved full commit. Only a derived private copy with the exact
leading marker removed is recognized. That diagnostic creates no live approval.

## Outcome

The owning canonical PR-flow tool recognizes the actual native passing format
without rewriting raw comments or relaxing identity, commit, scope, chronology,
cohort, required-check, settlement or merge gates. Fresh adopted-tool collection
can then evaluate the untouched ETA evidence normally.

## Scope

One shared portable pure lexical helper for legacy unmarked or exactly one
observed leading receipt-v1 envelope with LF LF; use it in the existing commit
hydration prefilter, issue-verdict and issue-completion recognizers. Registered
law/policy/CLI regressions and matching canonical contract/skill wording. Keep
later raw body text visible to existing incomplete-scope revocation. Same PR38
may carry this plan and later qualified implementation beside the distinct
already approved withdrawal task; their estimates and exits remain separate.

## Non-goals

No new collector, query, pagination, identity list, resolver, workflow, model,
credential, paid route, approval alias, generic HTML/whitespace normalization,
multiline verdict search, rule waiver, deployment, social action or heartbeat
resumption. Never edit a native Bot comment or apply a transformed diagnostic
fixture as live evidence. Do not broaden the two-point withdrawal task.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Independently review this one-point scope and complete eleven-child parent
   accounting before Ready. The existing ten direct children reconstruct the
   reviewed historical41 boundary; this distinct1 proposes42 for that same
   parent UUID63a0e4ff-353f-4c90-ab8a-7241d958d54c. It is not remaining effort
   or a re-estimate of the broader conditional75-point program. Use qualified
   Rheos for the reviewed inventory comment, estimate and actual readback.
2. After native readiness, causal registered RED shows the actual marked format
   misses hydration, passing-verdict and completed-issue recognition while
   existing unmarked controls retain their behavior. Preserve native JSON/body
   bytes; full-commit resolution belongs in separate test input/stubs.
3. GREEN accepts only the legacy prefix or one exact leading observed envelope.
   Unknown or repeated leading markers, altered envelopes, arbitrary leading
   whitespace and quoted/fenced/example wrappers remain ineligible. Later
   quoted/literal marker text is not a new independent veto. No trim or scan.
4. Existing trusted Bot identity, exactly one raw Reviewed-commit marker, actual
   native full-SHA resolution and exact-head checks remain. Both legacy and
   wrapped incomplete verdicts, including later marker text, revoke prior
   same-head approval and provide no completed issue cohort. Unknown identity,
   stale/ambiguous binding, missing scope and later negative/dismissal ordering
   retain their current refusals. Every ordinary review/merge gate remains.
5. All registered owning law, policy, isolated CLI, portable, flow, contract and
   zero-warning lint gates pass. Current protected personal source review and
   head-guarded MERGE precede qualified installation/adoption. Only then collect
   fresh untouched native ETA evidence and run the canonical gate; no promised
   approval, merge, throughput or live B1/B2/B3 result.

## Verification

Use the existing registered test_law.cljs, test_policy.cljs, test_cli.cljs and
portable runner, then pr.cljs flow, contract parsing and clj-kondo with zero
errors/warnings. Preserve full actual RED/GREEN logs, native raw comment hash,
source/tool revisions and append-only receipts/events. Source-only preparation
is not operational adoption.

## Risks

A broad whitespace/HTML repair could admit quoted/generated verdicts or hide
incomplete revocation. The candidate removes only one exact leading envelope;
all remaining body text and current gates retain their owners. Current native
format evidence does not establish when a provider changed it. This Incoming
card supplies no Ready, implementation or additional parent estimate write.

Planning scope clarification from independent read-only audit: matching format-only wording is limited to skills/pr-flow/SKILL.md coverage/approval sections and skills/pr-flow/CONTRACT.edn approval/coverage/scope clauses, preserving accepted withdrawal2 edits in those shared files. V2 hash-bound proposal remains historical. No new semantics, identity list, settlement change or additional point. Current status stays Incoming1; parent42 remains a reviewed proposal, not an applied estimate.
